description: This file defines the ProtobufCodec class, which implements serialization, copying, and type filtering for Protocol Buffers messages within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for deep copying messages, checking supported types, reading and writing protobuf messages, and managing message parsers.

classes.name: ProtobufCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing protobuf serialization, deep copying, and type filtering for Orleans messages, supporting the IGeneralizedCodec, IGeneralizedCopier, and ITypeFilter interfaces.

methods.name: ProtobufCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with type selectors for serialization and copying, filtering by the 'protobuf' alias.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a protobuf message using its size calculation and parser.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for serialization by this codec, considering the 'protobuf' alias and type filters.

methods.name: IsProtobufMessage
methods.description: Determines if a given type is a protobuf message by checking for parser availability.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a protobuf message from the binary reader, handling type information and unknown fields.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message to the binary writer, including type information and payload.
